findings.description: A cookie has been set without the secure flag, which means that the cookie can be accessed via unencrypted connections.
findings.mitigation: Whenever a cookie contains sensitive information or is a session token, then it should always be passed using an encrypted channel. Ensure that the secure flag is set for cookies containing such sensitive information.
findings.title: Cookie Without Secure Flag

findings.description: A cookie has been set without the SameSite attribute, which means that the cookie can be sent as a result of a 'cross-site' request. The SameSite attribute is an effective counter measure to cross-site request forgery, cross-site script inclusion, and timing attacks.
findings.mitigation: Ensure that the SameSite attribute is set to either 'lax' or ideally 'strict' for all cookies.
findings.title: Cookie Without SameSite Attribute

findings.description: A timestamp was disclosed by the application/web server - Unix
findings.mitigation: Manually confirm that the timestamp data is not sensitive, and that the data cannot be aggregated to disclose exploitable patterns.
findings.title: Timestamp Disclosure - Unix
